content: Jcamic mexla nech'ob chic jmul chkij che xkamjon recomendar ki' kayon. Owe xnech'ob che ajoj nc'atzina jle' carta de recomendación chka tak nokba ewq'uin y tak nok-el ela ewq'uin, ajni' chca jle' chic wnak jxeba ewq'uin.

Per ixix mism ixocnak ix ajni' jun carta jnokrbanbej recomendar chca wnak, jun carta jtz'ibtanak ptak kanm, jun carta je nsiq'uisa cmal conjelal wnak com bien cutkin che conjelal ajni' utzlaj samaj rxin Dios jkabnon checjol.

Bien k'alaj ix ajni' jun carta per jun carta bnon rmal Cristo, y ajoj xokojchowa jcarta chca wnak. Per mtint ta csan che rtz'ibxic carta per c'aslic Dios xucsaj Espíritu Santo che rtz'ibxic, jun carta jtz'ibtanak ptak canm wnak y me chwech ta tz'lem tak abaj tz'ibtanak wa'.
Ajoj bien kutkin che xkaban jun utzlaj samaj rxin Dios checjol per xe rmal Cristo tak xokocwina xkaban jsamaj, y Dios rutkin chcara' xkaban.
Per wexte xkayon jara' nte majo'n nak nokocwina nkaban, mesquier nokocwina xtekbij ta chc'ola jun rsamaj Dios xekwankersaj kayon kaja, per jara' xruyon ruq'uin Dios npe wa' njelal jnokocwina nkaban.

Com Dios arja' rey-on chka che nokocwina nquektijoj wnak tzrij c'ac' chuminem rxin Dios, jun chuminem je nnataj Espíritu Santo chka, mjara' ta nnataj chka jun ley rxin Dios jchek tz'ibtanak. Cara' c'a rbanic com rley Dios jchek tz'ibtanak jara' xnuc'ut chkawech che nokcoma rmal kil kamac, per Espíritu Santo jara' nuya' jun c'ac' c'aslemal chka.

Jnabey chuminem xe cmic rec'mon ta, xe chwech tz'lem tak abaj tz'ibtanak wa'. Per c'ola ruch'a' Dios rexbilan ta chuminem y ruplaj Moisés ch'a'an rmal, y rmal c'ara' me xc'och'taj ta cmal aj Israel xquetz'et ruplaj. Per ruch'a' Dios jrexbilan ta nabey chuminem jara' xe nq'uisa ruk'ij.
Wc'ola ruch'a' Dios rexbilan ta jun chuminem rxin nabey peor c'ara' jsamaj je ntajina nuban Espíritu Santo chpam jawra jun c'ac' tiemp jokc'ol wa', jara' más chna k'axnak na ruch'a' Dios nrexbilaj.

Cara' rbanic com jchuminem je ncatruc'om ela chpam nimlaj rpoknal wcongan ruch'a' Dios rec'mon ta peor c'ara' jc'ac' chuminem je nchumsana awxin ruq'uin Dios y ja' Dios nbij chawa che rbeyal chic awc'an, jara' más k'axnak na ruch'a' Dios rec'mon ta.
Jchuminem jcongan ruch'a' Dios rexbilan ta nabey per camic xe mnim ta ruk'ij chwech jc'ac' chuminem, com jc'ac' chuminem más k'axnak na ruch'a' Dios rec'mon ta.
Jchuminem je nk'axa ruk'ij wcongan ruch'a' Dios rec'mon ta peor c'ara' jc'ac' chuminem je nmajo'n nk'ax ta ruk'ij jara' ajni'la k'axnak ruch'a' Dios rec'mon ta.
Com ajoj ykula kac'u'x ruq'uin jun chuminem jmajo'n nk'ax ta ruk'ij rmal c'ara' tak bien nekk'alsaj na je c'tun chkawech.

Moisés ojer arja' xwiwaj ruplaj y xubutz tzra jun tziak per ajoj camic majo'n chic nc'atzin ta chka che nekwiwaj kaplaj. Ja' Moisés xubutz ruplaj ch-utz c'ara' jruch'a' Dios jc'ola chuplaj me ttz'a'ta cmal aj Israel tak nk'axa ruk'ij.

Je aj Israel arj-e' xsa'cha cna'oj, nmajo'n xch'obtaj ta cmal nak rbanic. Com arj-e' camic tak necsiq'uij jtz'ibtanak cana chpam jun chuminem rxin nabey per nmajo'n nch'obtaj ta cmal nak rbanic, ajni' c'c'o na tziak je nwiwana chquewech. Wneyke'a quec'u'x ruq'uin Cristo tzra' c'ara' nch'obtaj wa' cmal nak rbanic jun chominem rxin nabey.
Per nmajo'n ch'obtanak ta cmal camic com tak nsiq'uisa pquexquin rley Dios jtz'ibtanak cana rmal Moisés jara' com ajni' c'ola jun tziak butzben rwech canm je nwiwana chquewech nak rbanic.
Per tak neyke'a quec'u'x ruq'uin Kajaw Jesucristo jara' nela tziak jbutzben rwech canm y nch'obtaj chic cmal nak rbanic.
Y camic quenbij chewa, jKajaw Jesucristo xjun quebnon ruq'uin Espíritu y wc'ola Espíritu awq'uin je rxin Kajaw Jesucristo jara' atelsan chic libre pruk'a il mac.

Y ajoj konjelal je ykula kac'u'x ruq'uin Kajaw Jesucristo majo'n nak ta butzben kaplaj, kamjon rtz'etic camic jKajaw Jesucristo más k'axnak na ruch'a' Dios ruq'uin. Y com kamjon rtz'etic chcongan nim ruk'ij rmal c'ara' tak noktajina nokq'uextaja, ntajina noca kna'oj ajoj ajni' rna'oj ja', chka ajni' npe más y más ruch'a' ptak kanm. Y njelal jawrara ruq'uin Espíritu npe wa' je rxin Kajaw Jesucristo.
